title: Selector Type Fallback Stacks
pattern: Chaining fallback synchronous attempts sequentially inline to recover from service failures.
why_bad: Amplifies execution latency and couples caller directly to multiple alternative backend implementations.
detection: Deep nested conditional fallback calls on failure return states of distinct services.
counterexample: Standard error handling where a single local backup (like a local cache file) is checked once on failure.
fix: Decouple via a broker, or route through a structured gateway.
